_comment: Tests Ryde Health node 2c complaint intake. triage-v2 (2026-09-30): triage rewritten to the spec in STEP 1 (A red-flag escape route with emergency vs see-a-doctor tiers, B caller's own words, C/D/E capped at three questions asked once each, F unresolved allowed, G acupuncture/dry needling, I what's-the-difference, J handoff line). Old scenarios that certified booking straight away on a bare body-area complaint, a needle-comfort check, a modality-explanation sentence after triage, and a physio 'mechanism' skip were rewritten. Escape routes, pricing carve-out, due-rank presentation and STEP 7 fallback scenarios are otherwise unchanged. asap-default: STEP 4 never asks a timeframe question.

scenarios.name: Back pain with a duration between ACUTE_WEEKS and PERSISTENT_MONTHS and nothing else resolves it -> asks D, not C again

history.content: I've been getting really bad lower back pain, it's been going on for about two months

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent's only spoken output this turn is the D question (hands-on treatment vs an exercise-based plan, asking for a preference or 'happy to go with what the practitioner suggests'), with no tool call. Duration was already given so C is not asked; two months is between 6 weeks and 3 months so it does not resolve. FAIL if the agent asks the C question again, names modalities as a menu, says which approach is best, books, or asks two questions.

scenarios.name: Whole-body complaint with no body area is not out of scope and is not booked on -- asks C

history.content: I've just been feeling really run down and achy all over, like my whole body is stiff

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent treats it as something the clinic can help with and its only spoken output is the C question ('How long has it been bothering you, and have you tried anything for it so far?' or the equivalent), no tool call. FAIL if it says the clinic does not treat this, goes straight to availability, or asks more than one question.

scenarios.name: Caller names acupuncture -- no question, no needle check, moves to the availability search

history.content: I've been feeling really run down, exhausted, and I can't sleep properly -- I was wondering if acupuncture might help with that

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks no triage question and no needle-comfort question, and moves toward the availability search (a bridge line and/or smart_voice_agent recommend_availability with categories that include Acupuncture 158224 and no practitioners). It may also carry the caller's other eligible modalities only if it added them by rule; naming acupuncture alone is enough to use it. FAIL if it asks the C, D or E question, asks about needles, or claims acupuncture will help with sleep or fatigue. NOTE: the STEP 2 male/female practitioner preference question (not a triage question) may come first; when it does, judge only that no C/D/E question was asked and that no non-eligible modality was chosen.

scenarios.name: Caller hands over the choice -- D is never asked, pool goes on unforced

history.content: My knee's been sore for a few weeks -- honestly not sure what I need, whatever you think is best

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks no question (a knee is not back or neck, so duration alone does not resolve it, and 'whatever you think' counts as no preference at D) and moves to the availability search with categories for the BASE POOL (Physiotherapy 158245, Chiropractic 382287, Osteopathy 158220 and/or 1401284885292779040) with no single modality forced; a bridge line before the tool call. FAIL if it asks the D question, asks about hands-on vs exercise, or says which modality is best. NOTE: the STEP 2 male/female practitioner preference question (not a triage question) may come first; when it does, judge only that no C/D/E question was asked and that no non-eligible modality was chosen.

scenarios.name: Caller pivots to cancel during intake — routes to cancel_intent with a filler phrase

history.content: My knee has been bothering me after my run last week
Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on, or more of a rehab and strengthening focus?
Actually, never mind — can I cancel my appointment instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent', in the same turn (per the ESCAPE ROUTE OUTPUT FORMAT). FAIL if agent continues the intake flow, asks a qualifying question before routing, omits the filler phrase, or speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Plain pricing question during intake routes to PRICING QUERY, not INFO PIVOT

history.content: I've been getting really bad lower back pain, it's been going on for about two months

Oh, that's not ideal — you've come to the right place. Are you after something more hands-on — joint work and manual therapy to get things moving and reduce the pain directly? Or more of a rehab and exercise focus, understanding what's causing it and building strength so it doesn't keep coming back?
Actually, before I decide — how much does a physio session cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set and calls universal_router intent='get_service_price' (the system prompt's PRICING QUERY path — stays in this node, does not eject to info_pivot). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' for a plain, uncombined pricing question.

scenarios.name: Combined price+duration question still routes to INFO PIVOT (regression guard)

history.content: How much does a physio session cost and how long does it run?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' (system prompt's COMBINED ASK SCOPED EXCEPTION routes same-turn price+duration asks to info_pivot/Node 8). FAIL if agent calls get_service_price directly for this combined ask, or fails to call any tool.

scenarios.name: Caller only wants to check an existing appointment — routes to details, not cancel_intent

history.content: Hi, can you just check what time my appointment is for on Thursday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says "Checking that now, one moment." and calls universal_router intent='details' (system prompt's PATIENT APPOINTMENT LOOKUP, PHASE A). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' for a pure check/confirm request with no cancel or reschedule language.

history.content: I've been getting shoulder pain from gardening

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent'. FAIL if agent routes to intent='details' or continues the complaint-intake flow instead of escaping.
